schema:
CREATE TABLE Customers (cust_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, signup_date DATE);
CREATE TABLE Orders (cust_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date DATE NOT NULL, amount INTEGER, channel TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (cust_id, order_date), FOREIGN KEY (cust_id) REFERENCES Customers (cust_id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.signup_date) = '2020' AND T2.amount >= 100

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant includes non-functionally-determined filtered child table column T2.amount in SELECT DISTINCT, failing to deduplicate customers who have multiple qualifying orders with distinct amounts >= 100.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.signup_date, T2.amount FROM Customers AS T1 INNER JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.signup_date) = '2020' AND T2.amount >= 100

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant includes non-functionally-determined unfiltered child table column T2.channel in SELECT DISTINCT, failing to deduplicate customers who have multiple qualifying orders across different channels.
